subject: Extend shadow journal with per-note recall→outcome attribution
description: Add SkillOpt-style usage-attribution telemetry to the KB learning loop (design in note:note-mqfl5llz4rj). Scope: when a task's judge verdict is produced (approve/kickback), log the set of RAG-recalled KB notes that were in that task's context alongside the outcome — extending the existing shadow-journal flywheel (note:note-mqefyksc2io) to per-note granularity. This is the FREE implicit-lift signal (tier 2 of the design): no extra bench runs, piggybacks on judge verdicts the loop already emits. Downstream (separate task) the learner drain consumes this attribution to promote provisional→durable notes by accumulated lift and demote negative-lift notes, benching against a pinned KB snapshot to fix the non-reproducibility in note:note-mqbbndrgd1k. This task is ONLY the attribution-logging seam, not the gate/promotion logic. Acceptance: each judge verdict writes a journal record {task_key, outcome, recalled_note_keys[]}; verify the records appear for a real judged attempt.
